requirements.title: Welcome to Opal Therapy

requirements.title: Employee handbook
requirements.summary: How Opal works day to day.

requirements.title: Workplace injury and workers compensation information
requirements.summary: How to report an injury, who to notify, and how injury management works.
requirements.instructions: This explains your right to claim, what Opal will do, and who is responsible for injury management. You are not asked to provide any insurance document — workers compensation cover is Opal's obligation, not yours.

requirements.title: Personal details
requirements.summary: Your legal name, date of birth and contact details.

requirements.title: Emergency contact
requirements.summary: Who we should contact in an emergency.

requirements.title: Bank details for pay
requirements.summary: Where your pay should be deposited.
requirements.instructions: These details are encrypted and visible only to payroll-authorised staff. After you save them, only the last four digits are ever displayed.

requirements.title: Tax details
requirements.summary: Your tax file number declaration details.
requirements.instructions: You can complete this here, or complete the ATO's online commencement forms through myGov and give us the summary. If you have no tax file number, or are exempt from quoting one, the ATO requires the paper form — tell us and we will arrange it.

requirements.title: Superannuation fund
requirements.summary: Choose the super fund your contributions should go to.
requirements.instructions: If you do not nominate a fund, we will ask the ATO whether you have a stapled fund that follows you between jobs. Super now has to reach your fund within days of each payday, so settling this before your first pay matters.

requirements.title: Stapled super fund determination
requirements.summary: Request the employee's stapled fund from the ATO where they have not nominated one.

compliance.title: Stapled super fund request
compliance.appliesTo: Employees who start without nominating a fund

requirements.title: Payroll setup
requirements.summary: Configure the employee in payroll before their first pay run.

compliance.title: Payday Super — SG must reach the fund within 7 business days of payday

requirements.title: Identity verification
requirements.summary: Confirm your identity so we can complete your employment records.
requirements.instructions: Tell us which document you will present. In most cases we will sight it and record the details rather than keep a copy — that is both what the regulators prefer and less of your personal information for us to hold.

requirements.title: Right to work in Australia
requirements.summary: Confirm your entitlement to work in Australia.
requirements.instructions: Australian citizens and permanent residents provide evidence of that status. Visa holders consent to an online work-rights check — a tax file number, Medicare card or driver licence is not enough on its own.

requirements.title: Ahpra registration
requirements.summary: Your registration as an occupational therapist.

compliance.title: Ahpra registration as an occupational therapist
compliance.appliesTo: Anyone using the protected title "occupational therapist"

requirements.instructions: Enter your Ahpra registration number. We verify it against the public Register of Practitioners — a screenshot is not sufficient.

requirements.title: Occupational therapy qualification
requirements.summary: Your occupational therapy degree, institution and completion year.

compliance.title: Qualification and professional association evidence for NDIS audit
compliance.appliesTo: Registered providers of allied health supports

requirements.title: Professional indemnity arrangements
requirements.summary: Confirm the professional indemnity arrangement that covers your practice.

compliance.title: Professional indemnity insurance arrangements (OT Board registration standard)
compliance.appliesTo: Registered OTs other than students / non-practising

requirements.instructions: This may be Opal's cover, your own policy, or a combination. We record which arrangement applies and check it against the Board's standard — we do not simply assume our policy covers you.

requirements.title: Continuing professional development

compliance.title: Continuing professional development (OT Board registration standard)
compliance.appliesTo: Registered OTs other than students / non-practising

requirements.title: Driver licence
requirements.summary: Your driver licence, for community and home-visit work.

requirements.title: NDIS Worker Screening Check

compliance.title: NDIS Worker Screening Check
compliance.appliesTo: Risk-assessed roles and key personnel of REGISTERED providers

requirements.summary: Your WA Working with Children Check card details.

compliance.title: Working with Children Check (WA)
compliance.appliesTo: Child-related work as defined in s.6 of the Act

requirements.instructions: Provide your card or application number and family name. We validate it with the WA Screening Unit and register you so we are notified if your card status changes.
